Class Date

java.lang.Object
parking.Date
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Date>
public class Date extends Object implements Comparable<Date>
Date class that represents a calendar date with a year, month, and day. It is used as part of the timestamp of a parking activity and can check whether the date is a valid calendar date.

  • Constructor Details

    • Date

      public Date(String date)
      Create a date from a string in the format yyyy-mm-dd. If the string is not in this format, the date is set to an invalid date, which can be detected by isValid().
      Parameters:
      date - the date as a string, such as 2026-03-09.

    • Date

      public Date(int year, int month, int day)
      Create a date with the given year, month, and day.
      Parameters:
      year - the year of the date.
      month - the month of the date, from 1 to 12.
      day - the day of the month.

    • isValid

      public boolean isValid()
      Check if the date is a valid calendar date. The month must be from 1 to 12, and the day must be from 1 to the number of days in the month; February has 29 days in a leap year.
      Returns:
      true if the date is a valid calendar date; false otherwise.
